title: Billy Meier's faked photos including dinosaur from a book

plain: Some of the photographs taken by Billy Meier, a man in Switzerland known for his pictures of supposed alien craft and creatures, were faked, and one dinosaur image was copied from a book. The researcher Clas Svahn says this, adding "I have that book at home." He is pointing to the source he says the picture was copied from, which would undercut Meier's photos.
